blocks.text: Renewing the African American Civil Rights Network Act

This bill reauthorizes for seven years the African American Civil Rights Network. The network is a National Park Service (NPS) program that designates historical sites and educational resources that are connected to the African American civil rights movement from 1939 to 1968. The program expired on January 8, 2025.
Locations, facilities, and resources included in the network are eligible to use the network logo and receive technical support from the NPS.
This bill renews a National Park Service program called the African American Civil Rights Network for seven more years. The program had expired on January 8, 2025.

The network recognizes historical sites and educational resources linked to the African American civil rights movement between 1939 and 1968. Places, facilities, and resources that are part of the network can use the network's logo and get technical support from the National Park Service.
